{07 15 00}Even once you've found a

{07 00 00}Fossils are very fragile,{01 00 00 0f 00}
like poor {04 01 00}. You

{07 0b 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, did you

lunch, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}When I'm out hunting for
dinosaur bones and stuff, I
lose track of time.
{07 06 00}One time, I got so hungry
that I started gnawing on a
bone I'd dug up!

{07 16 00}I'm worn out from digging
all day, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 0e 00}Maybe I should go home and
make myself a hot cup
of {04 13 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

be pretty tough to find
any fossils, {07 15 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 06 00}But what if I'm just about
to find the perfect fossil?

{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, do you want to
join me for a little fossil
hunting, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
It can be slow work, and I'd
love to have a little
company while I dig around.

{07 00 00}Fossils are the remains of
creatures that lived
thousands of years ago{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

is like digging up chunks of
history, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 01 00 01}

here.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, you'll let me
